title: Packaging, Versioning, Install, Update, Migration & Round-Trip
objective: Extend the prepared MAS Adventure workspace with deterministic packaging, versioning, install/update/migration and round-trip preparation over MAS-01..18 while preserving canonical owner, resource/provenance and platform/runtime authority and keeping package/install/migration plans distinct from actual publication, installation or canonical mutation.

scope.purpose: Represent deterministic Adventure packaging/version/install/update/migration/round-trip preparation without treating a prepared package or migration plan as proof of publication, installation, update or canonical owner mutation.
scope.completion_gate: A representative MAS workspace can deterministically prepare package/version/install/update/migration/round-trip structures over completed MAS foundations with explicit owner references and fail-closed invalid states while preserving canonical owner/resource/platform authority and never treating prepared package or migration artifacts as proof that publication, installation, update or migration occurred.

selection_boundaries: Owner Continue on 2026-09-16 governed-started MAS-19; implementation authority is limited to work/mas-19-packaging-versioning-install-update-migration-round-trip.
MAS-01 through MAS-18 remain completed foundations and must not be reopened silently.

Prepared package/version/install/update/migration/round-trip structures remain planning/projection semantics and must not publish content, install packages, apply updates or migrations, mutate canonical owner/resource/platform state or claim those operations occurred.
Package/resource/provenance/platform/install/migration owner seams must be resolved from existing live application contracts during targeted dependency loading rather than invented.
Existing MAS validation family remains active; no family transition occurs in MAS-19.
MAS-20 retains Collaboration, Review, Adaptation & Publication Workflow scope and must not be pulled forward.
CNI-12 and PCA remain unselected; MAS-20+ and SMB-08 remain unauthorized.
next_action: Resolve only package/resource/provenance/platform/install/migration owner seams needed by MAS-19, establish causal RED on the named application branch, then implement minimum deterministic non-mutating preparation behavior.
